poseDescriptions.idle.0: Steady long-blade guard, command mantle naturally half-open.
poseDescriptions.idle.1: Shoulder/chest lift, open-hand gesture and mantle opening differ.
poseDescriptions.move.0: A extension phase: leading foot extended, rear leg bent; mantle trails.
poseDescriptions.move.1: B passing phase: knee raised, both leg shapes compressed; mantle closer.
poseDescriptions.move.2: A-prime extension phase: similar to0 with smaller knee/arm/mantle differences; not a wholly new gait phase.
poseDescriptions.move.3: B-prime passing phase: similar to1 with smaller knee/arm/mantle differences; not a wholly new gait phase.
poseDescriptions.attack.0: Windup1: sword raised behind shoulder, elbows bent, knees flexed; no forward release.
poseDescriptions.attack.1: Windup2: body compresses/leans further, blade still behind shoulder and elbow bent; no forward release.
poseDescriptions.attack.2: Release-hit: strong forward sword extension with lunge, opened trailing command mantle.
poseDescriptions.attack.3: Recovery: torso rises, sword returns diagonally to side and mantle closes.

sources.sourceReview: Actual four back move cells inspected: complete held sword, clear leg/knee/wing positions, no frontal face. Same approved identity. Other v02 cells excluded. Final black-background QA found orphan paper speckles; technical cleanup uses background-neutral238/chroma20 and only the large connected actor contour per cell, preserving the connected crown/blade/mantle and softalpha. No redraw or binaryalpha.

poseValidation.familyScaleEvidence: One common .66 scale preserves the longest back release blade completely inside512; no individual frame bbox scaling. AI source blade extends across the nominal592 cell, so connected pose extraction retains those pixels without taking its neighbor.
